db:select.db:sql:
SELECT
campaign_id,
campaign_name,
campaign_status,
approved_by,
approved_at,
active_from,
active_to,
owner_email
FROM campaigns
WHERE campaign_id = :campaignId

raise-error.description: Mode must be DRY_RUN, PREVIEW, or EXECUTE

db:select.db:sql:
SELECT
campaign_id,
campaign_name,
campaign_status,
approved_by,
approved_at,
active_from,
active_to,
owner_email
FROM campaigns
WHERE campaign_id = :campaignId

raise-error.description: Campaign is outside its active date range

db:select.db:sql:
SELECT execution_id, execution_status,
matched_count, eligible_count, excluded_count
FROM campaign_executions
WHERE campaign_id = :campaignId
AND idempotency_key = :idempotencyKey
LIMIT 1

raise-error.description: This campaign has already been triggered with the supplied idempotency key.

db:insert.doc:name: Acquire Campaign Lock
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO campaign_execution_locks (campaign_id, execution_id, idempotency_key, locked_at) VALUES (:campaignId, :executionId, :idempotencyKey, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

db:select.doc:name: Verify Campaign Lock Ownership
db:select.db:sql: SELECT execution_id FROM campaign_execution_locks WHERE campaign_id = :campaignId AND execution_id = :executionId

raise-error.description: Another execution is already processing this campaign. Retry after it finishes.

db:select.db:sql:
SELECT
c.customer_id,
c.customer_name,
c.email,
c.phone,
c.push_token,
c.timezone,
EXISTS (
SELECT 1
FROM customer_consents cc
WHERE cc.customer_id = c.customer_id
AND cc.channel = 'EMAIL'
AND cc.consent_given = TRUE
AND cc.withdrawn_at IS NULL
AND (
cc.expires_at IS NULL
OR cc.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
) AS email_consent,
EXISTS (
SELECT 1
FROM customer_consents cc
WHERE cc.customer_id = c.customer_id
AND cc.channel = 'SMS'
AND cc.consent_given = TRUE
AND cc.withdrawn_at IS NULL
AND (
cc.expires_at IS NULL
OR cc.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
) AS sms_consent,
EXISTS (
SELECT 1
FROM customer_consents cc
WHERE cc.customer_id = c.customer_id
AND cc.channel = 'PUSH'
AND cc.consent_given = TRUE
AND cc.withdrawn_at IS NULL
AND (
cc.expires_at IS NULL
OR cc.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
) AS push_consent,
EXISTS (
SELECT 1
FROM suppression_list s
WHERE s.channel = 'EMAIL'
AND s.address_hash = LOWER(SHA2(TRIM(c.email), 256))
) AS email_suppressed,
(
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM customer_contact_history h
WHERE h.customer_id = c.customer_id
AND h.channel = 'EMAIL'
AND h.contacted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
) AS recent_email_count,
(
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM customer_contact_history h
WHERE h.customer_id = c.customer_id
AND h.channel = 'SMS'
AND h.contacted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
) AS recent_sms_count,
(
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM customer_contact_history h
WHERE h.customer_id = c.customer_id
AND h.channel = 'PUSH'
AND h.contacted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
) AS recent_push_count
FROM customers c
WHERE c.customer_status = 'ACTIVE'

db:insert.db:sql:
INSERT INTO campaign_recipient_log (
execution_id,
campaign_id,
customer_id,
channel,
masked_address,
outcome,
exclusion_reason,
idempotency_key
)
VALUES (
:executionId,
:campaignId,
:customerId,
:channel,
:maskedAddress,
:outcome,
:exclusionReason,
:idempotencyKey
)
db:insert.db:input-parameters:
#[{
executionId: vars.executionId,
campaignId: vars.campaign.campaign_id,
customerId: payload.customer_id,
channel: payload.channel,
maskedAddress: '***',
outcome: payload.outcome,
exclusionReason: payload.exclusion_reason,
idempotencyKey:
vars.idempotencyKey
++ '-'
++ payload.customer_id
++ '-'
++ payload.channel
}]

db:update.db:sql:
UPDATE campaign_executions
SET matched_count = :matchedCount,
eligible_count = :eligibleCount,
excluded_count = :excludedCount,
execution_status = 'EVALUATED',
completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE execution_id = :executionId

db:select.db:sql:
SELECT
template_id,
campaign_id,
channel,
subject,
message_body
FROM campaign_templates
WHERE campaign_id = :campaignId
AND is_active = TRUE;

db:insert.doc:name: Persist Scheduled Campaign Message
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO campaign_scheduled_messages (execution_id, campaign_id, customer_id, channel, idempotency_key, scheduled_send_at, message_payload, status) VALUES (:executionId, :campaignId, :customerId, :channel, :messageKey, :scheduledSendAt, :messagePayload, 'PENDING')
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ executionId: vars.executionId, campaignId: vars.campaign.campaign_id, customerId: payload.customer_id, channel: payload.channel, messageKey: vars.idempotencyKey ++ '-' ++ payload.customer_id ++ '-' ++ payload.channel, scheduledSendAt: (payload.scheduledSendAt >> "UTC") as LocalDateTime, messagePayload: write({ correlationId: vars.executionId, eventType: 'CAMPAIGN_MESSAGE', idempotencyKey: vars.idempotencyKey ++ '-' ++ payload.customer_id ++ '-' ++ payload.channel, executionId: vars.executionId, campaignId: vars.campaign.campaign_id, channel: payload.channel, scheduledSendAt: payload.scheduledSendAt, recipient: { customerId: payload.customer_id, address: payload.recipient, timeZone: payload.timeZone default 'UTC' }, message: { customerName: payload.customer_name, subject: payload.subject, body: payload.message } }, 'application/json') }]

db:update.doc:name: Update Queued and Deferred Execution
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE campaign_executions SET queued_count = :queuedCount, deferred_count = :deferredCount, execution_status = 'QUEUED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE execution_id = :executionId

email:body.email:content:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- "CAMPAIGN PREVIEW REPORT

" ++ "Campaign: " ++ (vars.campaign.campaign_name default "") ++ "
" ++ "Campaign ID: " ++ (vars.campaign.campaign_id default "") ++ "
" ++ "Execution ID: " ++ (vars.executionId default "") ++ "

" ++ "Matched Customers: " ++ (vars.matchedCount as String) ++ "
" ++ "Eligible Messages: " ++ (vars.eligibleCount as String) ++ "
" ++ "Excluded Messages: " ++ (vars.excludedCount as String) ++ "

" ++ "PERSONALIZED MESSAGES

" ++ ( (vars.personalizedMessages default []) map ((item) -> "Customer: " ++ (item.customer_name default "") ++ "
Channel: " ++ (item.channel default "") ++ "
Recipient: " ++ (item.recipient default "") ++ "
Subject: " ++ (item.subject default "") ++ "
Message: " ++ (item.message default "") ++ "
------------------------------
" ) join "
" )

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { executionId: vars.executionId, campaignId: vars.campaign.campaign_id, campaignName: vars.campaign.campaign_name, mode: vars.requestMode, matchedCount: vars.matchedCount, eligibleCount: vars.eligibleCount, excludedCount: vars.excludedCount, queuedCount: vars.queuedCount default 0, deferredCount: vars.deferredCount default 0, recipientDecisions: vars.recipientDecisions, personalizedMessages: vars.personalizedMessages }

db:delete.doc:name: Release Campaign Lock After Error
db:delete.db:sql: DELETE FROM campaign_execution_locks WHERE campaign_id = :campaignId AND execution_id = :executionId

db:delete.doc:name: Release Campaign Lock After Success
db:delete.db:sql: DELETE FROM campaign_execution_locks WHERE campaign_id = :campaignId AND execution_id = :executionId

set-payload.doc:name: Build Final JSON Response
set-payload.value: #[write({ executionId: vars.executionId, campaignId: vars.campaign.campaign_id, campaignName: vars.campaign.campaign_name, mode: vars.requestMode, matchedCount: vars.matchedCount, eligibleCount: vars.eligibleCount, excludedCount: vars.excludedCount, queuedCount: vars.queuedCount default 0, deferredCount: vars.deferredCount default 0, recipientDecisions: vars.recipientDecisions, personalizedMessages: vars.personalizedMessages }, 'application/json')]

db:update.doc:name: Recover Stale Message Claims
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE campaign_scheduled_messages SET status = 'PENDING', claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND claimed_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE

db:update.doc:name: Claim Due Scheduled Messages
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE campaign_scheduled_messages SET status = 'PROCESSING', claim_token = :claimToken, claimed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND scheduled_send_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP() ORDER BY scheduled_send_at, id LIMIT 50

db:select.doc:name: Read Claimed Messages
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, channel, CAST(message_payload AS CHAR) AS message_payload FROM campaign_scheduled_messages WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = :claimToken ORDER BY scheduled_send_at, id

db:update.doc:name: Mark Scheduled Message Published
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE campaign_scheduled_messages SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL WHERE id = :messageId AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = :claimToken

db:update.doc:name: Return Unpublished Messages to Pending
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE campaign_scheduled_messages SET status = 'PENDING', claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = :claimToken
